prompt.project_info: Create a raw photorealistic high-fidelity K-beauty close-up selfie.
prompt.main_subject: Approved adult East Asian woman with long glossy dark-brown waves, contemporary K-beauty makeup, realistic glass-skin micro-texture, playful confident gaze, wearing a grey pinstriped structured top with white collar and silver hardware.
prompt.composition_elements: Slightly high-angle selfie, extreme close-up on face and shoulders, decorative silver hair clip and heart earrings, neutral blurred studio wall, direct eye contact, relaxed closed-mouth smile.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft even beauty light with catchlights, balanced neutral-warm color, high clarity without plastic skin or heavy airbrushing.
prompt.technical_specs: 85mm portrait lens, very shallow depth of field, realistic high-fidelity digital photograph, natural hair and fabric detail, low noise.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: A raw photorealistic high-fidelity close-up selfie of an approved adult East Asian woman with long glossy dark-brown wavy hair, contemporary K-beauty makeup, realistic dewy skin micro-texture, rosy blush, and glossy pink lips. She looks directly into the lens with a playful confident closed-mouth smile. She wears a grey pinstriped structured top with a white contrasting collar, silver snap buttons, and circular hardware, with a decorative silver hair clip and heart earrings. Use a slightly high-angle extreme close-up on face and shoulders, 85mm portrait lens, very shallow depth of field, neutral blurred wall, soft even beauty light, clear catchlights, realistic pores and hair strands, and balanced warm color.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, underage, childlike, halter top, tongue out, open mouth sexualization, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-airbrushed, harsh shadows, outdoor setting, distorted features, motion blur, digital artifacts, watermark, extra fingers, public figure likeness.

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Attach the required approved-adult reference. Preserve face, hair, makeup, top, accessories, and close-up composition; identity may be replaced by another approved adult. Keep any graphic details subordinate and omit logos or typography.

changes: Clarified approved adult and replaced halter styling and tongue-out/open-mouth sexualized gesture with a structured top and closed-mouth playful smile; retained K-beauty concept.
